tagline: Track records per holder and start over
summary: A single list of records, each belonging to a holder and worth a quantity of points; mark one complete, total each holder's points, and start every record over at once.

stats.label: Holder A total
stats.rule: sum of Quantity where Holder is Holder A and Complete is true

stats.label: Not complete
stats.rule: count of rows where Complete is false

actions.label: Start over
actions.confirm_text: Start over? Every record is marked not complete.

journeys.title: adds a record and shows it in the list
journeys.steps: Add a record with Name, Holder 'Holder A' and Quantity '5'; save
journeys.expect: The record is listed without the Complete badge

journeys.title: rejects an empty required field
journeys.steps: Add a record with Name blank; save
journeys.expect: The form shows 'Name is required.' and nothing is added

journeys.title: marks one record complete
journeys.steps: Use Mark complete on a record that is not complete

journeys.title: edits the quantity of a record
journeys.steps: Edit a record and change Quantity to '3'; save
journeys.expect: The record shows the new quantity

journeys.title: deletes a record
journeys.expect: The record is no longer listed

journeys.title: filters to one holder
journeys.expect: Only that holder's records are listed

journeys.title: totals a holder's points
journeys.steps: Read the Holder A total stat
journeys.expect: The stat sums the completed records of that holder

journeys.title: starts every record over at once
journeys.expect: No record shows the 'Complete' badge any more

journeys.title: preserves records across a browser refresh
journeys.steps: Add a record; refresh the browser
journeys.expect: The record is still listed with the same values

omitted_patterns.reason: The idea asks only to start over, not to keep what came before

assumptions: Starting over marks every record not complete rather than deleting it
A record counts toward its holder's total only once it is complete
